organization.name: Teclib'
organization.notes: Official history: GLPI created in 2003 by INDEPNET; Teclib founded in 2009 and became official editor in 2015. Age uses Teclib company formation, not project origin. Subscription revenue supports project development. Outside equity financing and current investors unresolved; no bootstrapped assertion.

pricingTiers.name: GLPI community core
pricingTiers.notes: GPL community core; exclusive Network plugins and commercial services separate.
No unique vendor popular designation verified.

pricingTiers.name: GLPI Network Standard
pricingTiers.notes: Closest organizational self-host subscription: Standard€300/month excluding VAT, up to 50 technical staff or 5000 assets, and 2 production instances. Annual total not verified; Basic separately€100/month.

pricingTiers.name: GLPI Network Enterprise
pricingTiers.notes: Self-host Enterprise€4500/month excluding VAT, unlimited inventoried assets and all exclusive Network plugins. Annual billing terms and total unverified.

moats.claim: Inventory, service management and plugin integrations accumulate organizational process history that can make migration costly.

productReasons.claim: Asset inventory and CMDB relationships connect equipment records with service operations.
Tickets, problems, changes and knowledge workflows let teams investigate incidents alongside assets.
Contract, budget and financial tracking connect technical inventory to asset lifecycle decisions.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project/company sources; no separate corporate sponsor verified. Verified business steward supplied as fallback.

requirements.notes: Pinned 12.0.0 composer verified; older 10/11 matrix not used for 12 PHPminimum.
Currentmatrix lists My SQL 8 for GLPI 11; exact 12 minimum unresolved, confirm release preflight.
Currentmatrix lists Maria DB 10.6 for GLPI 11; exact 12 minimum unresolved.
Nginx uses PHP-FPM; webroot must point to public directory.

requirements.component: Official GLPI Docker or Podman image
requirements.notes: Bundled application runtime; database and persistent volumes still configured.
Official image includes a minute scheduler by default; can disable on webnodes when dedicating a worker.

resources.notes: No universal CPU/RAM/disk minimum verified; inventory, plugins, attachments and background work determine sizing.

selfHosting.notes: Pinned GLPI 12.0.0 composer requires 64-bit PHP 8.3+. Official install guide verifies My SQL/Maria DB families but its version matrix stops at 11; exact 12 database minimum remains unresolved. Native PHP or official container route; Docker or Podman, with bundled cron worker. No mandatory independent Redis/queue identified.

oneClickInstall.notes: Reviewed official install docs and Docker repository. Manual image/Compose configuration and automatic database initialization are not a verified one-click provider template; none found.
